name: Action CI

on:
  push: &action-changes
    paths:
      - action.yml
      - github-action/**
      - plugins/codex-security/examples/completed-scan/**
      - .github/workflows/action-ci.yml
  pull_request: *action-changes
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: action-ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: github-action

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - &actions-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - &actions-setup-node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
      - &set-up-the-ubuntu-sandbox
        name: Set up the Ubuntu sandbox
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap apparmor-profiles
          sudo apparmor_parser -r /usr/share/apparmor/extra-profiles/bwrap-userns-restrict
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run validate
      - name: Install the pinned CLI for integration tests
        run: npm ci --prefix runtime --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Published CLI result and SARIF compatibility (no model calls)
        run: npm run test:cli
      - name: Packaged Linux configuration smoke test (no model calls)
        run: node scripts/linux-smoke.mjs
      - name: Save generated release metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: action-release-metadata
          path: github-action/build/*.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

  smoke:
    name: Hosted Action smoke test (${{ matrix.name }})
    # Fork PRs are unsupported; their push workflows exercise the Action instead.
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: OpenAI default
            provider: ""
            model: ""
          - name: Bedrock
            provider: amazon-bedrock
            model: openai.gpt-5.6-luna
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - *actions-setup-node
      - *set-up-the-ubuntu-sandbox
      - name: Run the packaged Action without credentials or model calls
        id: smoke
        uses: ./
        with:
          provider: ${{ matrix.provider }}
          model: ${{ matrix.model }}
          dry-run: "true"
      - name: Verify dry-run outputs
        env:
          SCAN_STATUS: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.scan-status }}
          SKIP_REASON: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.skip-reason }}
          EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.exit-code }}
          SCANNED_SHA: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.scanned-sha }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          SARIF_UPLOAD_READY: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.sarif-upload-ready }}
        run: |
          test "$SCAN_STATUS" = skipped
          test "$SKIP_REASON" = dry-run
          test "$EXIT_CODE" = 0
          test "$SCANNED_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          test "$SARIF_UPLOAD_READY" = false

  dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - *actions-checkout
      - *actions-setup-node
      - name: Check action dependencies
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      - name: Check locked CLI dependencies
        if: always()
        run: npm audit --prefix runtime --omit=dev --audit-level=high
